prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic raw backstage lounge selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with wavy hair, soft facial features, natural pores, and a playful smile, wearing a black sequined fashion top with a modest neckline, silver star embellishments, and opaque black trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing candidly with hands relaxed behind or beside the back, slight natural lean, plush carpet and dark lounge background, with optional decorative HOLLYWOOD lettering treated as generic set typography rather than a real brand.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct flash in a dim room, high contrast, bright highlights, hard shadows, slight film grain, glamorous late-night backstage mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro Max selfie, 8K detail, raw sharp focus, realistic fabric and skin texture, no filter.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic raw 8K iPhone 15 Pro Max selfie of an approved adult blonde woman with wavy hair, natural pores, soft features, and a playful smile in a dim backstage dressing room or lounge. She wears a black sequined fashion top with a secure modest neckline, silver star embellishments, and opaque black trousers. She stands with a relaxed candid stance and a slight natural lean. Include plush carpet and a dark background; optional generic HOLLYWOOD-style decorative lettering may appear as set typography without real branding. Use harsh direct flash, high contrast, sharp focus, film grain, and realistic texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, corset, bodysuit, deep cleavage, garters, fishnet stockings, impossible proportions, bursting seams, tongue-out sexualized expression, nudity, trademark logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve backstage setting, flash contrast, sequins, black palette, and approved-adult identity; replace wardrobe with equally opaque fashion if needed. Any HOLLYWOOD text is optional generic set typography and must not become a real logo.

changes: Replaced extreme anatomy, deep cleavage, corset bodysuit, garters, fishnets, and suggestive expression with modest fashion coverage and natural proportions.
